briefs.claim_en: Drinking hot water mixed with lemon juice will destroy the coronavirus.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple sources from March to May 2020, including AP News, FactCheck.org, and AFP Fact Check, state that drinking hot water mixed with lemon juice does not destroy the coronavirus or prevent/cure COVID-19. These claims circulated online during the early stages of the pandemic. Experts and health organizations, such as the National Academies, confirmed that acidic drinks like lemon juice have no effect on coronavirus infections and will not stop the virus. The Guardian reported in March 2020 on governments advising social media companies to remove such "dangerous quack cures."
